item.title: Add an ArgoCD git generator ApplicationSet
item.description:
The next gitops task for my home cluster was to make ArgoCD automatically install new applications when I add them to the configuration git repository.

In this post, I’m going to show how to set up an Argo CD git generator ApplicationSet and point it at a specific directory in a configuration repository.

item.title: Install MQTT into k8s
item.description:
Now that the cluster is up and has Argo CD controlling application deployment, I’m starting to move my homelab services out of docker-compose stacks and into my k8s cluster.

I run MQTT (Eclipse Mosquitto in my case) as a message bus between zigbee2mqtt, zwave-js-ui and Home Assistant, so it’s the first service I’m moving into the k8s cluster.
